entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant and learned APP for the State.
2.

The petitioner seeks bail in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 313,
506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has antecedent of four cases and is in custody since 25.04.224.
It is next submitted that a purely consensual relation has been given the colour of rape.

4. At this stage, the learned counsel appearing on Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.43876 of 2024(3)
dt.05-10-2024 behalf of the informant Mr. Akash Raj
submits that he has instructions not to oppose the regular bail application of the petitioner.
